content: A single bracelet does not jingle; it takes two to make music.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: One brass bracelet worn on the wrist moves in total silence. Only when a second bracelet strikes against it does a bright, resonant ring fill the air. Human life finds its music, its meaning, and its joy in the lively dialogue and companionship of another.
practicalInsight: Reach out to collaborate with someone today. Allow your ideas to strike against theirs to make music.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you stubbornly trying to make music all by yourself, resisting the harmony of partnership?
